none: PAS NLM-11B124: Roman Unidentified Object from Belton
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Lead alloy. Unknown object. A small cast slightly curving strip with a rectangular lug. The object appears complete, and bears cast lettering or numerals in Roman capitals on both sides of the strip. This inscription reads; IIIIVXXXX on one side, and XVI on the other. Patinated overall. Suggested date: Possibly Roman, 40-400. Length: 18.7mm, Width (at lug): 8.9mm, Thickness: 2.2mm, Weight: 1.74gms
